Thanks Sophie — super helpful. Below is the initial pricing sketch; I’ve attached the workbook with the line items filled in. High level: 

Baseline Hosted (on-demand):
- US region (standard models): $10 / 1M tokens
- EU region premium: +25% => $12.50 / 1M tokens
- Rationale: EU infra and smaller pool availability add ~20–30% to host costs; we price to reflect regional capacity and cross-region egress.

Committed Dedicated (12-month reserve) — per 50M tokens/month profile:
- Committed (50M/mo) blended unit: ~$7.50 / 1M tokens in EU (≈40% discount vs EU on-demand)
- For 80M spikes, blended can go to ~$6.50 / 1M with higher commit or burst buffer rules
- Includes EU-only isolated pools (data residency, dedicated KMS/HSM integration available)

Cost examples (monthly):
- Hosted EU (50M tokens): 50 * $12.50 = $625/month
- Hosted EU (80M tokens peak): 80 * $12.50 = $1,000/month
- Committed Dedicated (50M profile): 50 * $7.50 = $375/month (plus minimum monthly commit billing/discount schedule — see workbook)

Notes / tradeoffs:
- The $/1M numbers above are illustrative for the model family we discussed. If you opt for larger models or extra context length, unit cost will rise ~10–30% depending on model.
- Dedicated reserved capacity requires an upfront commit and gives predictable unit economics and EU isolation for compliance.
- We can also apply quantization/optimized runtime recommendations (Redwood Optimize) that commonly drop billable $/1M by 10–25% for compatible workloads — I’ll call out specific model recommendations in the workbook.

Security/compliance:
- EU-dedicated pools support customer-managed KMS and HSM integrations, and we can include the SOC 2 evidence package in the SOW.
- Data egress: serving EU traffic from US-hosted backends will add egress and latency; for production we recommend EU-local serving.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Marissa — can you review the committed vs on-demand NH numbers and confirm if we can offer a further concession to meet Sophie’s $12/1M target on Hosted EU (either a temporary promotional credit or a short-term commit)?
2) Sophie — if the 50M committed blended of $7.50/1M is in the ballpark, I’ll put together a MAP with timelines and a draft SOW (incl. KMS/HSM add-on).
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk the workbook and MAP. I’ll propose slots after I hear back from Marissa.

Thanks —
Dylan
